category_definitions.increasing: confirmation z20 >= re-entry z20 + 0.5 AND entry z20 >= confirmation z20 - 0.25
category_definitions.remains_elevated: all three z20 values >= 1.0 after higher-priority directional categories
category_definitions.sharply_decreases: entry z20 <= re-entry z20 - 1.0 AND confirmation z20 <= re-entry z20 - 0.5
category_definitions.decreases_then_reincreases: confirmation z20 <= re-entry z20 - 0.5 AND entry z20 >= confirmation z20 + 0.5
category_definitions.other: does not meet a fixed category

entry_volume_availability: entry-candle volume is not known at the entry open; therefore entry-volume-based categories are diagnostic only unless explicitly delayed until entry candle close.
selection_rule: For each rolling split, choose the category with the highest training mean 12h net return among categories with >=3 training events; validate at 2/3/6/12h. No validation tuning.
